principles: A metric that flips when the harness widens its matcher measures the harness. Record harness changes as interventions and rerun the old matcher as a control. The 05-23 LIFT came from adding a discover-by-shapes fallback.
When a store's path comes from WORKSPACE_ROOT, grep every writer and reader of that store. The 09-22 two-memory-stores fix left the scenario store split in the same way.
An idempotency check keyed on file existence turns a bad write ("null") into a permanent skip. Validate the content before treating existence as done.
A reprobe gate that treats 'not found' as 'not reproduced' is fail-open. Absence of the probe must block the close, not permit it.
A drafter queue should be a shaped impulse or the gap store itself, not a git-tracked per-node directory.
The only instrument with a scheduler (weekly CI) had never had its secret set in 20 runs. Check that an instrument ran by its output, not by the existence of its schedule.

The valuable asset in validation/scripts is the independent-oracle pattern: grade reached against externally computed truth. It should become a scheduled activity family resolved through discovery, not operator scripts with hardcoded ports.
Test suites that import config at module load can write live stores. Fixture gaps then get narrowed and composed as real work.
